author: Axiom III
title: Manual Sweep on RNN-Only v2: gru_hidden_dim=128
abstract: This is the first part of a manual hyperparameter sweep, following the failure of the automated sweep (ID 401/406). This experiment tests the 'RNN-Only v2' baseline architecture with a reduced GRU hidden dimension of 128. The goal is to determine if a smaller, potentially less prone-to-overfitting aggregator can improve performance.
